en.headline: HKPAX stages two public ticketed shows today at East Kowloon Cultural Centre
en.dek: The Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo presents Paradisum and An Isolated Case this afternoon at the East Kowloon Cultural Centre, with tickets still available on URBTIX.
body: The Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo is staging two public ticketed performances today at the East Kowloon Cultural Centre, the Arts Development Council said.
Paradisum by Recirquel Cirque Danse from Hungary runs from 3pm to 4pm in the Hall. An Isolated Case follows from 3:30pm to 4:30pm in the Beats venue.
Standard tickets start from HK$180 and HK$220 respectively, with concessions available. Tickets are on sale through URBTIX.

zh.headline: 香港演藝博覽今於東九文化中心呈獻兩場公眾售票演出
zh.dek: 香港演藝博覽今天下午於東九文化中心上演《天境重生》及《純屬個別事件》，門票現於城市售票網發售。
body: 香港藝術發展局表示，香港演藝博覽今於東九文化中心呈獻兩場公眾售票演出。
匈牙利Recirquel Cirque Danse的《天境重生》於下午3時至4時在劇院上演。《純屬個別事件》則於下午3時30分至4時30分在樂館舉行。
正價門票分別由180元及220元起，設有優惠。門票現於城市售票網發售。
